description: Final QA polish: ErrorBoundary component wrapping all routes, loading/Suspense enhancements, accessibility improvements, performance optimizations, page titles, favicon, OG meta, 404 polish, console.log cleanup
steps: Create src/components/shared/ErrorBoundary.tsx - class component that catches render errors, shows branded dark glass error card with emerald retry button, error message display, and 'Back to Dashboard' link. Include componentDidCatch for error reporting hook
Update src/App.tsx to wrap each route page element in ErrorBoundary. Keep Suspense at top level but add ErrorBoundary inside each Route element wrapping the lazy component
Enhance src/pages/NotFound.tsx with navigation suggestions (links to Dashboard, Inventory, CRM, Sales) below the back button, animated with motion
Create src/hooks/useDocumentTitle.ts - simple hook that sets document.title with 'PageName | StockFlow' pattern

Add useDocumentTitle calls to key pages: Dashboard ('Dashboard | StockFlow'), Products ('Products | StockFlow'), etc. Update at minimum: Dashboard.tsx, Products, Customers, Leads, SalesOrders, AIAssistant, SettingsPage, Branches page
Update public/favicon.svg to be a proper emerald SF monogram (if current one is generic, replace with matching design)
Add aria-labels to all icon-only buttons in TopNav.tsx and Sidebar.tsx (hamburger menu, collapse, notifications, search, AI bot)
Ensure all Dialog/Sheet components in the app have proper focus management (radix already handles this, but verify aria-labels on triggers)
Remove any console.log statements from production code (search all src/ files and remove dev logs)
Verify all routes in App.tsx use React.lazy (already done) and confirm no direct imports of page components exist
acceptance_criteria: ErrorBoundary component exists and wraps route pages
useDocumentTitle hook exists and is used in key pages
No console.log statements in src/ files (except error handling)
All icon-only buttons have aria-label attributes
pnpm build passes with zero TypeScript errors
findings: Found 3 console.log statements in Products.tsx, Warehouses.tsx, Suppliers.tsx - removed and prefixed unused params with underscore for TS strict. No other console.log in src/. Existing console.warn/debug in services/monitoring are appropriate for error handling. Favicon was a generic lightning bolt - replaced with SF monogram.
